It isn’t possible to know whether UA9020 on 2027-06-15 will be on time.

Reasons:
- Real-time status tools only report flights close to departure; they don’t predict punctuality years ahead.
- Schedules and even flight numbers can change before 2027, so UA9020 on that date may not even exist in its current form.
- Airlines don’t publish any reliable “will this exact flight be on time in 3 years?” data.

What you can do:
- About 24 hours before departure: check UA9020’s status for 2027-06-15 (on United’s site/app or by asking me again with that date).
- For planning now: build in buffer time for connections and important arrivals, and prefer earlier flights in the day if on-time performance is critical.

If you tell me where you’re connecting or what you’re trying to make (meeting, cruise, etc.), I can suggest how much buffer to plan for.</action>
